prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ assignBins }`.

`assignBins(items, capacities)` receives two arrays of equal length or different lengths. Every item must be a plain object `{ id, units }`, where `id` is a non-empty string and `units` is a positive integer. Item IDs must be unique. Every capacity must be a non-negative integer.

Process items in input order. Assign each item to the lowest-index bin whose remaining capacity can hold all its units. Reduce that bin's remaining capacity after assignment. An item that fits nowhere is unassigned. Return `{ assignments, unassigned, remaining }`. Each assignment is a new object `{ itemId, binIndex }`; `unassigned` contains item IDs in processing order; and `remaining` is a new capacity array.

Empty arrays are valid and produce empty corresponding results. Throw `TypeError` if either argument is not an array or any entry is malformed, including duplicate IDs, `NaN`, fractions, and negative capacities. Validate all input before allocating. Do not mutate either array or any item object. Use only the JavaScript standard library.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
